Checked Blender 4.5 mixed-rig bake selection and FBX export scope, Unity clip import settings, practice pack labels and the companion’s automatic map updates.
runtimeStatus: B&W 0.3.0 has been tested in-game, as confirmed by the maintainer on 2026-11-01. This audit does not assign invented per-feature test coverage. The LLW 440-19 model author confirmed the separate A-19 prototype worked in-game. Its three baked cycles and wheel-phase/reverser blend apply to that conventional model. A clean official ADK with Unity 6000.3.26f1 passed automated headless checks for conventional and articulated practice locomotive previews, independent section speeds, ordinary comparison, and building and reopening one player pack. In-game validation of the general 0.4.0 runtime remains open. The steam-plant proposal planned for 0.4.0 is an author-review document, not a working example pack or a gameplay-validation claim. The final combined artifact passed these isolated checks on Railroader 0.6.2 build 26335745 / Unity 6000.3.26f1. Fresh combined gameplay, editor, save/reload and multiplayer acceptance remain separate; the earlier maintainer-confirmed in-game testing is retained without expanding its coverage.
followUp: Check the reusable runtime in-game on the same practice pack with B&W enabled, disabled and absent. Have a first-time author try the workflow, and qualify the AE’s six takes on the actual locomotive.
Reconcile the steam-plant proposal with modder feedback and the eventual implementation before publishing supported authoring examples or Railroader compatibility claims.
Complete separately authorized combined gameplay, editor, save/reload and multiplayer acceptance; re-audit compatibility after game updates.
